title: 3 Everyday Habits Damaging Your Home's Pipes
description: Small habits around the house can lead to unexpected plumbing issues over time. One common mistake is relying on chemical drain cleaners. While they seem quick and easy, harsh chemicals can erode your pipes and cause long-term structural damage. Another frequent issue is flushing wipes or paper towels. Even products labeled flushable often fail to dissolve properly, creating stubborn blockages in main sewer lines. Finally, over-tightening plumbing connections during minor DIY fixes can strip threads or crack plastic fittings, causing subtle leaks behind walls. To protect your home's infrastructure, stick to basic maintenance and consult a licensed plumber when drains slow down.
